about: Story quests (systems_design.md section 17), done one at a time in order: each quest's next is the one after it (null = the last for now). places: spots in the Tha Phae Gate frame ([x along the wall, z out onto the square], metres; the player starts at [0, 20]). npcs: who stands where, and how they look (the same choices as the character screen; the name stays empty, the Thai name is in th.ts). Steps: reach (walk to within radius metres of a place), talk (to an npc; the lines are in th.ts story under the step's line id), defeat (count monsters, of one species or any when species is null), dodge (come through count red warnings unhurt: out of the ring, a perfect dodge or a guard). reward: exp, and learn names what the step taught (shown on the card). Quest and line ids are kept in saves: never rename them.
